sentences.en: Every house should have at least one carbon monoxide detector.
sentences.zh: 每一栋房子至少应该安装一个一氧化碳探测器。

sentences.en: The results of a lie detector test are inadmissible in court.
sentences.zh: 测谎仪测试的结果在法庭上是不能作为证据的。

sentences.en: The script Tatoeba needs the most is the native speaker detector.
sentences.zh: Tatoeba脚本最需要的是母语者识别工具。

senses.zh: 探测器；检测器；发现者；侦察器
